verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting explicitly supports creating queries/expressions across multiple data sources and consolidated alert management (grafana-docs-1, grafana-docs-25), with notifications routed to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie, VictorOps (grafana-gh-7), and OnCall for escalation/schedules/incident coordination (grafana-docs-6, grafana-docs-19). Community evidence corroborates that alerting works across heterogeneous data sources in production (grafana-comm-5), though one comment notes added operational complexity from needing Alertmanager/extra services (grafana-comm-8). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation detail on notification grouping/silencing mechanics and independent hands-on validation of silencing specifically.
